raw_tokens.value: A Galtan agitator can captivate a crowd once per day, as per the spell enthrall. (DC %1). During the spell's effect, the Galtan agitator can attempt a DC 15 Charisma check to increase her individual or organizational influence with the members of the crowd by 1 rank or step. Or, if the crowd members' attitudes toward the Galtan agitator are indifferent or worse, this check can improve their attitudes by 1 step. The Galtan agitator can never use this ability to increase her individual or organization influence or improve the crowd's attitude by more than 2 ranks or steps.|10+RogueLVL/2+CHA
